intro.en: AICC is the internal consulting and innovation lab of the Bank for the adoption of artificial intelligence. It explores and proves the use of AI with the functions of the Bank, delivers measured outcomes, and sets the way in which the Bank adopts AI at scale, with accountability that stays with people.

AICC serves the functions of the Bank. A function brings a need, AICC commits to an Engagement, delivers a Solution with its evidence, and supports it at the agreed level. The Business Model states the offer, and the Engagement workflow shows how a function works with AICC.
intro.ru: Раздел описывает услуги, которые AICC предоставляет функциям Банка, решения, которые он создаёт, и порядок обращения функции в AICC.

intro.en: AICC works by one method: Initiatives are taken in and decided in the Portfolio, Solutions are delivered, released, and operated through the Solution Lifecycle, and the work runs on a common cadence and is measured. The workflows show the flow, and the guides explain it.
intro.ru: Раздел излагает метод AICC: как принимаются и решаются инициативы, как создаются, выпускаются и эксплуатируются решения, как организован ритм работы и как она измеряется. Процессы показывают ход работы, руководства поясняют его.

intro.en: AICC is a joint team, led by the AICC Lead and formed of the people whom the functions of the Bank assign to it. Seven Roles carry the work, decisions are taken at defined levels, and the Steering and the Board Committee advise and oversee. The charter names Roles; the persons who hold them are recorded in the Appointments Record of the Registry.
intro.ru: Раздел излагает роли AICC, уровни принятия решений и органы, которые консультируют и решают. Лица, исполняющие роли, названы в Журнале назначений Реестра; устав называет только роли.

intro.en: The Bank uses AI under rules that are proportionate to risk. Each Solution has a Risk Tier, is checked or validated before use, and is overseen by people who can stop it. The AI Policy states the rules, the Risk Tiers, the review of providers, the handling of AI Incidents, and the Exceptions, within the AI Risk Appetite Statement of the Bank.
intro.ru: Раздел излагает правила использования ИИ в Банке: уровни риска, проверки и валидацию перед использованием, оценку поставщиков, обработку инцидентов ИИ и исключения. В нём есть ссылки на Заявление о риск-аппетите ИИ и на контрольные точки поставки.

intro.en: AICC is controlled, reported, and assured through five control loops, a catalogue of thirty-two controls, and the records that evidence them. The AICC Lead reports each quarter, the Executive Sponsor issues the report to the Board Committee, and internal audit gives independent assurance. The status of each control at a date is kept in the Control Matrix of the Registry.
intro.ru: Раздел излагает, как осуществляются контроль, отчётность и обеспечение уверенности в AICC: контуры контроля, записи и свидетельства, каталог контролей и отчётность перед комитетом совета. Статус каждого контроля на дату ведётся в Матрице контролей Реестра.

intro.en: The thirteen templates are the forms of the records that AICC produces, from the Initiative Brief to the Quarterly Report. A template gives the form; the rules for the record are in the documents.
intro.ru: Раздел содержит тринадцать шаблонов: формы записей, которые ведёт AICC. Шаблон задаёт форму, а правила ведения записи изложены в документах.

intro.en: The Vocabulary defines the terms of the charter, the Document Catalog lists its documents, the change history records their revisions, and Records and systems states where each record is kept.
intro.ru: Раздел содержит Словарь, Каталог документов, историю изменений документов и страницу, которая указывает, где хранится каждая запись.

text.en: To make artificial intelligence a trusted, everyday capability of the Bank: to prove its value with the functions that serve our customers, to set the standard by which the Bank adopts it, and to keep every use of it accountable to people, so that the Bank serves its customers better, works with greater confidence, and leads with care.

AICC is an internal consulting and innovation lab of the Bank. It explores, trials, and proves the use of AI with the functions, delivers the outcome, and proposes what the Bank should adopt at scale. It works as a consulting unit does: it engages with a function on a defined scope, delivers an outcome with its evidence, and keeps its commitments and its records in order.

AICC exists to enable the Bank to adopt AI as a governed capability that delivers measured value. The adoption improves the quality, speed, and consistency of the operations and services of the Bank, and serves its mission to improve people's lives with digital products and services. The direction is clear: from governed foundations, through assistants and embedded AI, to bounded agents under human oversight, with accountability for every Solution with a named individual.

The Bank pursues seven Strategic Priorities, from customer intelligence to software engineering, each resting on a governed foundation of people, data, and a shared AI Platform. Each Strategic Priority advances at its own pace through five Maturity Levels, and a level is reached when its Measures are met.

A function brings a need to AICC. AICC takes it in as an Initiative, probes it first as a minimum viable product, measures it against defined success Measures, and extends it only on that evidence. The work is visible, limited in progress, and paced by a common cadence. Before a Solution reaches its users, it is checked or validated by a person other than its builder, accepted by the Team, and accepted by the Domain Owner who asked for it. AICC applies this way of working to itself and is the example of what it proposes to the Bank.

AICC acts under the mandate of the Executive Sponsor, whom the Board names. It does not own or operate the AI Platform, own the business results of a Domain, set the rules of a Control Function, or validate its own work. The Control Functions stay independent and may stop a Solution, and internal audit gives assurance only. The AICC Lead reports each quarter, and the Board oversees AI through the Board Committee.

Each Solution is assigned a Risk Tier, which sets the review, validation, human oversight, and speed of release that apply to it. The Bank accepts risk from AI where the benefit is measured and the controls are proportionate, and it does not accept a breach of law or regulation.
Three values guide the work: integrity, prudence, and respect for people. The principles of adoption, application, work, and delivery follow from them.

intro.en: The values and principles of AICC follow the values of the Bank and the Statement of Intent on the adoption of artificial intelligence. They state what AICC stands for, how it decides, and how it delivers. AICC holds itself to them first, and asks the same of every Solution it proposes to the Bank.

applies.en: Three values guide every decision of AICC: integrity, prudence, and respect for people. They are the values on which the Bank adopts AI, and AICC is their first keeper. Where speed and value compete with them, the values prevail.

AICC adopts AI where it earns its place. These principles decide where AI is introduced, where it is extended, and where it is withdrawn, so that the Bank invests in what works and learns from what does not.

Every use of AI in the Bank answers to these principles, whether AICC built it or not. They are the commitment the Bank makes to its customers, its employees, its regulators, and its auditors: accountable, fair, explainable, private, secure, overseen by people, and compliant.
This is how AICC runs itself: close to the facts, quick to reverse, light on process, and measured by outcomes. AICC is the example of the way of working that it proposes to the Bank.

This is how the Teams of AICC build: visible, in small steps, value first, with quality and control built into the flow rather than added after it. Working Solutions and evidence count more than documents and opinion.

text.en: To make artificial intelligence a trusted, everyday capability of the Bank: to prove its value with the functions that serve our customers, to set the standard by which the Bank adopts it, and to keep every use of it accountable to people, so that the Bank serves its customers better, works with greater confidence, and leads with care.

intro.en: The charter is the body of knowledge of the AI Competence Center. It states how the unit is mandated, governed, and operated, and it is the source of truth for what AICC is, what it produces, and how it keeps its records. This page shows how the charter is organized on this site and where to start.

parts_lead.en: The charter has four kinds of content. Each answers one question, and each has its place on this site. The Registry and the Portfolio hold the records of the work; they are outside the charter and are not on this site.

routes_lead.en: A reader who is new to AICC reads About AICC, then What AICC does, and keeps the Vocabulary at hand. A reader with a purpose follows one of the routes below.

control.en: Every page of this site is generated from the documents of the charter at the baseline revision stated in the footer; where a page and a document differ, the document prevails. The Document Catalog states the status, the revision, and the life cycle of each document and template, and the AICC Lead activates them. Each document carries its change history, shown at the end of its page. The controls that can be tested are listed in the Operating Model, section 8, and the evidence of each is held in the Registry.

intro.en: The strategy of AICC is the strategy of the Bank applied to artificial intelligence. It starts from the mission and the Strategic Pillars of the Bank, is stated as seven Strategic Priorities, is carried through the way AICC invests, engages, delivers, and governs, and is measured along a road of five Maturity Levels. This page brings the strands together in one place; each points to the document that governs it.

bank_lead.en: The mission of the Bank is to improve people's lives with digital products and services. Its strategy rests on four Strategic Pillars. The adoption of AI serves each of them, as the Statement of Intent states, and the Strategic Priorities below are the themes through which it does so.

pillars_carried.Innovative leadership: Expertise at the point of work; Software engineering; Customer intelligence
pillars_carried.Financial inclusion: Customer intelligence; AI in banking operations and systems
pillars_carried.Shareholder value and dividends: Business intelligence; Adoption within Domains; Information technology operations and service lifecycle
pillars_carried.ESG goals: The Principles of Application and the AI Policy, across every priority

priorities_title.en: The AI adoption strategy: the Strategic Priorities

priorities_lead.en: The Bank pursues seven Strategic Priorities, stated in order, each resting on a governed foundation of people, data, and a shared AI Platform. They are the strategic themes of the Portfolio: the Executive Sponsor sets them with the Board, each with an Investment Envelope, and every Initiative that AICC takes in fits one of them.

aspects_title.en: The strategy across the aspects of AICC

aspects_lead.en: One strategy runs through every aspect of how AICC works. The table states, for each aspect, the strategic choice that the charter makes, who decides it, and where it is written.

aspects.choice: AICC is an internal consulting and innovation lab, not a cost center that charges its clients. It does not charge the functions; the Domain pays from its Investment Envelope for the run, the licenses, and the provider costs of a Solution, and the Executive Sponsor owns the budget of AICC itself. Value is tracked as the benefit that the function confirms and the flow of the work.
aspects.decides: Executive Sponsor; Domain Owners for the Solutions of their Domains

aspects.choice: Investment goes to Strategic Priorities and to the Teams through Investment Envelopes, one for each priority, set each year. Investment Guardrails state what may be committed without the Executive Sponsor and which Initiatives need the approval of the Executive Sponsor. Benefits are reported against the Envelope of each priority.
aspects.decides: Executive Sponsor, at the yearly Steering
aspects.read: AICC Charter 4; Statement of Intent 10 and 12

aspects.choice: Business initiatives are taken in, funded, continued, deferred, or rejected on evidence. The Portfolio runs on four loops, from the strategic loop of the year to the backlog care of the week, through a portfolio Kanban with a limit on the Active Initiatives. Every Initiative has a business case and is first probed as an MVP before the decision to continue.
aspects.decides: Executive Sponsor for the frame and the mix; AICC Lead for the flow

aspects.choice: AICC proves the use of AI with the functions and proposes what the Bank should adopt at scale; the Bank decides on the Proposals and the Domains execute. Each Domain applies the shared principles and standards within its own regulation, appoints Domain Experts, and uses AI in its own processes with governed knowledge. Shared AI Platform components, knowledge, and standards take precedence over individual Solutions.
aspects.decides: The Bank on each Proposal; the Domain Owners within their Domains
aspects.read: Business Model 2; Statement of Intent 5, 7, and 10

aspects.choice: A function brings a need, AICC commits to an Engagement in a Service Agreement on a best-effort basis within the capability it has, delivers an outcome with its evidence, and supports it at the agreed level. Either side may end or redirect the Engagement at the end of an Iteration.
aspects.decides: AICC Lead issues the commitment; the Domain Owner accepts the outcome

aspects.choice: Deliver in small steps: probe with an MVP, measure against the success Measures, then scale. Work is visible, limited in progress, and paced by Program Increments and Iterations on fixed dates. Quality and control are built into the flow: the check or validation and the controls of the AI Policy are steps of delivery, not a stage after it.

Every Solution has one of three types that sets its life: a Service that AICC runs for its whole life, a Product built for one consumer and supported on demand, or an Experiment that ends in a Proposal. AICC also oversees and reports on the Adopted Solutions that others deliver.
aspects.decides: Domain Owner approves the Solution Definition; AICC Lead assigns the Risk Tier
aspects.read: Solution Lifecycle Model 8; Portfolio Management Model 8

aspects.choice: One shared AI Platform serves the Bank, provided and operated outside AICC, with data separated as its classification requires. Data is classified, and the classification decides which data may reach which models and where they run. Knowledge sources have named owners and review cycles, and AI answers from approved, current, cited sources.
aspects.decides: Platform Owner for the Platform; AICC states the requirements

aspects.choice: AI augments the work of employees. Employees are trained by role before they use AI, each Domain appoints Domain Experts who enable adoption in that Domain, and AICC maintains training, templates, and communities of practice.
aspects.decides: Domain Owners for their Domains; AICC Lead for the training

aspects.choice: Providers of AI models and services are subject to due diligence, contractual terms, ongoing monitoring, and fallback and exit arrangements. The Bank is answerable for AI that it procures as for AI that it develops.
aspects.decides: Control Function Contacts and the Executive Sponsor, as the AI Policy states
aspects.read: Statement of Intent 6 and 10; AI Policy 4

aspects.choice: The Bank accepts risk from AI where the benefit is measured and the controls are proportionate to the Risk Tier, and it does not accept a breach of law or regulation. Each Solution carries a Risk Tier that sets its review, validation, human oversight, and speed of release. The Control Functions stay independent and may stop a Solution.
aspects.decides: Executive Sponsor decides the appetite; AICC Lead owns it; Control Functions validate

aspects.choice: AICC measures benefits realized against the Investment Envelope, the time from proposal to approval and from approval to acceptance, the value scored for the PI Objectives, the Domains and employees using approved Solutions, and the AI Incidents and control breaches. Progress on the road is measured by the Measures of each Maturity Level. The AICC Lead reports each quarter, and the Executive Sponsor issues the report to the Board Committee.
aspects.decides: Executive Sponsor sets the targets each year
aspects.read: AICC Charter 7; Statement of Intent 11.3 and 12

road_lead.en: The Bank advances the adoption of AI through five Maturity Levels. Each Strategic Priority advances at its own pace, and a level is reached for a priority when its Measures are met. The timing and the scope of advancement are set by the Executive Sponsor in the Priorities, not in the charter.

kept_title.en: How the strategy is set and kept

kept.en: The strategy is set once a year and kept every quarter. At the yearly Steering, in the first two weeks of December, the Executive Sponsor sets the Strategic Priorities, the Investment Envelopes, and the Investment Guardrails from the strategy of the Bank and the priorities of the Domains, reads the benefit against each Envelope and the results against each priority, and reviews the documents and the AI Risk Appetite Statement (Portfolio Management Model 4.2). At the quarterly Steering the Executive Sponsor confirms the Roadmap and the mix of Initiatives within the Envelopes, decides on each Active Initiative, and issues the Quarterly Report to the Board Committee (Portfolio Management Model 4.3, AICC Charter 7.2). The Statement of Intent is reviewed at least annually and on a material change in the use of AI, in a principal provider, or in regulation (Statement of Intent 13.3). The Strategic Priorities in force, with their Envelopes, are recorded in the Priorities Record of the Registry; this site states the strategy, and the Registry states its current state.
